ValidationRule.description: Unapproved projects face a log/exp/sqrt risk curve against budget, a time-prorated burn-rate ceiling (TRUNC/FLOOR/MIN/MAX), and whole-thousand budget and 5% completion step rules; null risk is skipped via ISNULL.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(Is_Approved__c), NOT(ISNULL(Risk_Score__c)), Risk_Score__c > 0, NOT(ISBLANK(Budget__c)), OR( ROUND(SQRT(Risk_Score__c) * EXP(-NULLVALUE(Completion_Pct__c, 0)) * LN(Risk_Score__c + 1), 3) > LOG(MAX(10, Budget__c)), AND( Budget__c > 0, NOT(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(End_Date__c)), TRUNC(NULLVALUE(Spent__c, 0) / MAX(1, Budget__c) * 100, 0) > FLOOR(100 * MIN(1, MAX(0, (TODAY() - Start_Date__c) / MAX(1, End_Date__c - Start_Date__c))) + CASE(TEXT(Priority__c), 'Critical', 30, 'High', 20, 10)) ), IF( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Draft')), OR( AND(Budget__c >= 10000, MOD(MFLOOR(Budget__c), 1000) <> 0), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Completion_Pct__c)), MOD(ROUND(Completion_Pct__c * 100, 0), 5) <> 0), MCEILING(NULLVALUE(Spent__c, 0)) - MFLOOR(NULLVALUE(Spent__c, 0)) > 1 ), FALSE ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Risk, burn rate, budget rounding or completion step breaks the math rules.
